'''Akindra''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Imperial Agent|Agent]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who was stationed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Akindra had [[Color/Legends|light]] skin.<ref name="TOR" />
